verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs cover creating flags, managing them in environments up to production, and a $0 forever tier, and community users confirm that flag changes stream to clients live. The 'within minutes of signing up' part is not evidenced: there is no quickstart or time-to-first-flag documentation, and the only hands-on account mentions a 24-hour hackathon implementation. Missing for 10: documented quickstart or onboarding flow, evidence of time-to-first-toggle measured in minutes, independent hands-on corroboration of fast setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Environments allow you to manage your feature flags throughout your entire development lifecycle, from local development through production.
LaunchDarkly clients download all flags in the project on connection, then stream changes.
